title: Glycan chip based on structure switchable DNA linker for on-chip biosynthesis of cancer-associated complex glycans
protocol: Pretreat thiol-modified single-stranded oligonucleotides with 1,4-dithiothreitol.
Mix single-stranded oligonucleotides (100 nmol), 1-O-allyl-D-lactose (100 nmol), and photoinitiator (10 nmol) in deionized water.
Stir the mixture under UV light (365 nm) using UVP Blak-Ray® XX-15 L UV bench lamp for 2 h.
Purify the mixture by normal-phase high-performance liquid chromatography with an LC-321 and OD-300 column using a linear gradient of acetonitrile in 0.1 M triethylammonium acetate (pH 7.0).
Dissolve single-stranded i-motif DNA in printing buffer to a final concentration of 70 μM.
Spot the i-motif DNA solution on gold-coated glass slide using a Microssys 5100 microarrayer with a Chip Maker 2 pin.
Incubate the slide for 12 h under 75% humidity.
Treat the slide with blocking solution.
Rinse the slide twice with PBS buffer (pH 4.5) and once with deionized water.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 min.
Mix 1 nmol lactose-oligonucleotide conjugates on the slide.
Agitate gently for 3 hours.
Wash the slide with 1X SSC solution containing 0.2% (w/v) SDS for 1 minute.
Wash the slide with 0.1X SSC solution containing 0.2% (w/v) SDS for 1 minute.
Wash the slide with 0.1X SSC solution for 1 minute.
Wash the slide with deionized water for 1 minute.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 minutes.
Prepare lactose disaccharide-immobilized slides as described above.
Divide lactose disaccharide-immobilized surface into several blocks using Gene Frame.
Drop solution of enzymes (4 mU) and nucleotide donors (10 mM) into all blocks to synthesize Globo H series from surface-immobilized lactose disaccharide in consecutive order.
Incubate each slide at 37 °C for 12 hours, 24 hours, 48 hours, and 72 hours in a humidified chamber.
Wash the slide once with washing buffer I.
Wash the slide twice with washing buffer II.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 minutes.
Drop PBS buffer (pH 4.5) onto the chip where enzymatic glycosylation was carried out.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 hours.
Collect the solutions and desalt them using an NAP-10 column.
Evaporate the eluted products.
Analyze the products by liquid chromatography with a CarboPac PA100 column and an Ag/AgCl reference electrode using isocratic elution mode with 100 mM sodium hydroxide.
Place the Envi-Carb SPE column in a 15 mL conical tube.
Equilibrate the Envi-Carb column using 80% (v/v) acetonitrile in 0.1% (v/v) trifluoroacetic acid and ultrapure water.
Spin at 60 × g for 50 s.
Add a 1 mL sample to the Envi-Carb column.
Wash the column with 2 mL of ultrapure water, 2 mL of 25% (v/v) acetonitrile, 1 mL of ultrapure water, and 2 mL of 10 mM triethylammonium acetate (pH 7.0).
Elute the final product with 2 mL of 25% (v/v) acetonitrile in 50 mM triethylammonium acetate (pH 7.0) and collect the product.
Dry the product to remove the solvent.
Dissolve the product in D₂O and measure nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR).
Prepare the slides for sequential enzymatic glycosylation.
Incubate the slides for 1 h with complexes of biotinylated GS-IB₄, RCA₁₂₀, SBA, LTL, and MAL II labeled by streptavidin-Alexa Fluor® 647 to assess the products of enzymatic reactions.
Wash the slides once with washing buffer I and twice with washing buffer II.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 min.
Scan the slides using a laser scanner for image acquisition.
Prepare the slides in which enzymatic glycosylations are sequentially completed under optimized reaction conditions.

Incubate the slides for 1 h with DyLight 650-conjugated anti-Gb5 monoclonal antibody, DyLight 650-conjugated anti-SSEA-4 monoclonal antibody and complexes of anti-Globo H monoclonal antibody (VK9) and anti-Gb3 monoclonal antibody labeled by goat anti-mouse IgG H&L-Alexa Fluor® 647.
Wash the slides once with washing buffer I and twice with washing buffer II.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 min.
Scan the slides using laser scanner for image acquisition.
Divide lactose disaccharide-immobilized surface into five different blocks using Gene Frame.
Drop a 25 μL solution of LgtC (4 mU), UDP-Gal (10 mM), Tris-HCl (100 mM; pH 7.0), and MgCl₂ (10 mM) into all five blocks.
Incubate at 37 °C for 48 h in a humidified chamber.
Wash the slide once with washing buffer I and twice with washing buffer II.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 min.
Drop a 25 μL solution of LgtD (4 mU), UDP-GalNAc (10 mM), Tris-HCl (100 mM; pH 7.0), and MgCl₂ (10 mM) into four blocks of Gb3 trisaccharide-synthesized five blocks.
Incubate at 37 °C for 48 h in a humidified chamber.
Wash the slide once with washing buffer I.
Wash the slide twice with washing buffer II.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 min.
Drop a 25 μL solution of LgtD (4 mU), UDP-Gal (10 mM), Tris-HCl (100 mM; pH 7.0), and MgCl₂ (10 mM) into three of four Gb4 tetrasaccharide-synthesized blocks.
Incubate at 37 °C for 72 h in a humidified chamber.
Wash the slide once with washing buffer I.
Wash the slide twice with washing buffer II.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 min.
Drop a 25 μL solution of α1,2-FucT (4 mU), GDP-Fucose (10 mM), Tris-HCl (100 mM; pH 7.0), and MgCl₂ (10 mM) into one of three Gb5 pentasaccharide-synthesized blocks.
Drop a 25 μL solution of α2,3-SialT (4 mU), CMP-Neu5Ac (10 mM), Tris-HCl (100 mM; pH 7.5), and MgCl₂ (20 mM) into one of three Gb5 pentasaccharide-synthesized blocks.
Incubate at 37 °C for 48 h in a humidified chamber.
Wash the slide once with washing buffer I.
Wash the slide twice with washing buffer II.
Dry the slide by centrifugation at 213 × g for 3 min.
Seed MCF-7 breast cancer cells in a 75 cm² culture flask filled with DMEM culture medium.
Seed MCF-10A normal breast cells in a 75 cm² culture flask filled with Mammary Epithelial Basal Medium (MEBM).
Incubate both cell lines at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere of 5% CO₂ and 95% air.
Subculture the cells every 3 days.
Detach the cells from the culture flasks.
Centrifuge the detached cells.
Mix Alexa Fluor® 488 hydrazide (1.75 μmol) with Globo H hexasaccharide (0.88 μmol) in 1 mL of 100 mM PBS buffer (pH 7.0).
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 6 hours in a humidity chamber.
Measure liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry to confirm the reaction product.
Treat collected MCF-7 and MCF-10A cells with Alexa Fluor® 488-conjugated Globo H hexasaccharide in culture medium at 37 °C for 1 hour in a humidified atmosphere of 5% CO₂ and 95% air.
Centrifuge each solution to remove the supernatant.
Wash the cells carefully with culture medium and DPBS.
Resuspend glycan-treated and nontreated cells in DPBS.
Culture MCF-7 breast cancer and MCF-10A normal breast cells as described above.
Treat both cell lines (4 × 10^5 cell/mL) with 4 nM calcein-AM in DPBS for 15 min.
Centrifuge each solution and remove the supernatant solution.
Wash the cells carefully with DPBS and culture medium.
Resuspend dye-treated cells in cell culture medium and apply these solutions onto the glycan chip at 37 °C for 1 h in a humidified atmosphere of 5% CO₂ and 95% air.
Wash the chip carefully once with cell culture medium and twice with DPBS.
Scan the chip using laser scanner.
Prepare calcein-AM-treated MCF-7 and MCF-10A cells as described above.
Resuspend dye-treated cells in cell culture medium.
Mix these cells in three ratios (MCF-7 cells accounted for 100%, 50%, and 10%) and apply them onto the glycan chip.
Wash the cells carefully with culture medium and DPBS.
Scan the chip using laser scanner.
